decisions.reason: Message 672 explicitly requires one accounted commission per primary mint regardless of code use, consistent leaderboard/NFT representation, and backfill of missing historical commissions; no matching Event exists.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
At this point, we have completed 12 mints, so that should amount to 12 tickets & 12 x $5 commissions.

**Even if no referral code is used, a ticket and commission are still issued**.

Currently, **when a code is used**, it is accurately reflected on the leaderboards/NFT attributes. Perfect.

If **no referral code is used**, the ticket and commission are assigned at random.
(B**ut they must still be reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes**.)

I believe that since your most recent fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 2 mints have been reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes. Great.
However, the missing tickets have not been backfilled.

The commissions from these purchases without a code are also still not reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes.

In my screenshot, you will see that I have an NFT showing 2 tickets but only 1 x $5 commission. That should not be possible because each ticket includes a $5 commission.

Also, in my leaderboard screenshot, only 7 tickets and 5 x $5 commissions are accounted for out of 12 total mints.
Whether or not a referral code is used, 12 mints should result in 12 tickets and 12 x $5 commissions.

value_updates.commission_view_consistency: Awarded $5 commissions from both code-used and no-code mints must be represented accurately and consistently in dashboard summaries, leaderboards, and per-NFT attributes.
value_updates.commission_count_basis: One $5 commission must be accounted for per completed primary mint, whether or not a referral code is used; secondary-market sales are excluded.

decisions.reason: The existing same-message metadata Event captures the ongoing attribute-consistency rule but omits the required historical backfill of missing ticket and commission attributes.

decisions.reason: The source changes accounting and backfill behavior, not the About page copy, whose no-code allocation description remains valid.
The code-used ticket issuance rule remains unchanged and is explicitly reported as accurate; the new concerns involve no-code allocation and accounting surfaces.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records one ticket for each no-referral mint; historical display and backfill obligations belong to accounting and metadata Requirements.
The source does not change the Small Block prize amount, trigger, eligibility window, funding, or draw mechanics.
The code-used commission rule remains unchanged and is reported as accurate; the source's unresolved commission behavior concerns no-code allocation and accounting displays.
Ticket and commission accounting does not change how prize winnings are delivered or claimed.
The source does not change winner-selection randomness, eligibility, weighting, provider, or verification behavior.
The source explains system accounting behavior but does not require a FAQ revision, and the existing FAQ already states that no-code commissions and tickets go to a random existing holder.

The existing same-message MODIFY already records one commission for every primary mint including no-code mints, while the prior state already records random allocation; display and backfill are separate accounting concerns.
Leaderboard ticket and commission accounting does not alter public prize-pool values or the next-draw sales counter.
